title: Why methane surged in the atmosphere during the early 2020s | Science
content: The atmospheric methane (CH4) growth rate surged after 2019, peaking at 16.2 parts per billion per year (ppb year−1) in 2020 before declining to 8.6 ppb year−1 in 2023. Using multiple atmospheric inversions constrained by observation- and model-based ...
